CHARTS.title: The United States — Sagittarius rising
CHARTS.sub: July 2, 1776 · ~5:10 PM LMT · Philadelphia · the locked chart

1.name: THE PEOPLE
1.groups: Support: markets, courts/law · Opportunity: press, legislature · **Crisis: opposition/land, foreign power, government** · Nagging: workers/military, intl finance · Adjacent: economy, hidden.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the national temper, vitality and prosperity of the populace itself

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the people's wages, purchasing power, household wealth

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: how the people talk — rumor, public discourse, the mood online

rows.label: home/land
rows.reading: the people's ground: land, housing, the rural base; the party out of power that courts them

rows.label: ventures/young
rows.reading: what the people bet on — retail speculation, entertainment, the birth rate

rows.label: labor/health
rows.reading: the people **as** workforce and rank-and-file; public health

rows.label: open enemies
rows.reading: who the people face abroad; foreign peoples as friend or foe

rows.label: debt/crisis
rows.reading: the people's debt and mortality; the foreign capital they're hooked to

rows.label: beliefs/law
rows.reading: the people's faith, ideology and their day in court

rows.label: their bosses
rows.reading: the authority over the people — the government in power

rows.label: their allies
rows.reading: the people's representatives and collective hopes; allied publics

rows.label: their undoing
rows.reading: what is done to the people in secret; subversion, prisons, self-undoing

2.name: THE ECONOMY
2.groups: Support: workers/military, government · Opportunity: opposition/land, hidden · **Crisis: markets, intl finance, legislature** · Nagging: foreign power, courts/law · Adjacent: people, press.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the raw state of money, banks and national wealth

rows.label: money
rows.reading: what funds the economy = trade, data, transport, the flow of information

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the economy speaks through the land — commodities, the productive base

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the economy's bedrock is the markets and speculation

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the economy's gambits = labor, production, the workforce

rows.label: daily function
rows.reading: the economy runs day-to-day on foreign trade and treaties

rows.label: rival/partner
rows.reading: the economy's great counterpart — **our money vs. the world's money** (the classic 2nd↔8th tension)

rows.label: crisis/rebirth
rows.reading: the economy's death-and-rebirth comes through law — bankruptcy, regulation, rulings

rows.label: governing belief
rows.reading: the economy's ruling ideology = the government's policy

rows.label: its authority
rows.reading: the economy answers to the legislature — taxation, the budget, appropriations

rows.label: its backers
rows.reading: the economy's hidden funders — shadow money, the parts of the system off the books

rows.label: its undoing
rows.reading: the economy's self-undoing is the people — a populace that won't spend, or revolts, sinks it

3.name: THE PRESS
3.groups: Support: foreign power, legislature · Opportunity: people, markets · **Crisis: workers/military, courts/law, hidden** · Nagging: intl finance, government · Adjacent: economy, opposition/land.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the media itself — its reach, tone and credibility

rows.label: money
rows.reading: what funds the press — and how the land/opposition bankrolls a narrative

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the press's own product = spectacle, the attention market

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the newsroom's base — its workers, and the service/defense beat

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the press's big gambits = foreign coverage, the war story

rows.label: daily grind
rows.reading: the press's daily function leans on big money — who owns the wires

rows.label: rival/partner
rows.reading: the press's open contest is with the courts (libel, the First Amendment, rulings)

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the press's life-or-death struggle is with the government — access, censorship, capture

rows.label: ideology
rows.reading: the press's worldview is legislative/ideological — whose hopes it carries

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: the press's reputation shades into the hidden — sources, leaks, what it won't print

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: the press's true allies (or marks) are the people

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the press's self-undoing is money — ad collapse, paywalls, the bottom line

4.name: THE OPPOSITION / THE LAND
4.groups: Support: intl finance, hidden · Opportunity: economy, workers/military · **Crisis: people, foreign power, government** · Nagging: courts/law, legislature · Adjacent: press, markets.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the party out of power, and the land itself, as a body

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the opposition's money = its donors, its speculation, its high-society backers

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the opposition speaks to/through labor and the ranks

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the opposition's base shades into the foreign — outside backing, the "foreign agent" charge

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the opposition's gambits draw on big outside money

rows.label: daily work
rows.reading: the opposition's daily function = lawfare, the courts, the long legal grind

rows.label: open enemy
rows.reading: the opposition's open enemy is the government in power (mutual: the govt's 7th is the opposition)

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the opposition's death/rebirth runs through the legislature — the next election, the floor fight

rows.label: ideology
rows.reading: the opposition's belief-life is partly hidden — the underground, the dissident network

rows.label: its standing
rows.reading: the opposition's bid for authority is its courtship of the people

rows.label: its allies
rows.reading: the opposition's allies/hopes ride on the economy — "it's the economy"

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the opposition's self-undoing is the press — bad coverage, the gaffe, the narrative

5.name: THE MARKETS
5.groups: Support: people, courts/law · Opportunity: press, foreign power · **Crisis: economy, intl finance, legislature** · Nagging: government, hidden · Adjacent: opposition/land, workers/military.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the exchanges, the speculation, the casino itself

rows.label: money
rows.reading: what feeds the markets = labor and production (and the defense sector)

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the markets talk in foreign terms — global flows, the carry trade

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the markets rest on international finance — leverage and the bond market

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the markets' offspring = legal structures (IPOs, securities law) and belief

rows.label: daily function
rows.reading: the markets' daily life answers to the government — rates, regulators

rows.label: rival/partner
rows.reading: the markets' counterpart = the legislature (the laws that bound them)

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the markets' death/rebirth lives in the hidden — the crash no one saw, dark pools

rows.label: belief
rows.reading: the markets run on the people's faith — confidence, sentiment, animal spirits

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: the markets answer ultimately to the real economy

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: the markets' allies = the press — the hype, the ticker, the hot tip

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the markets' undoing = the land/opposition — the real-asset reckoning, the populist backlash

6.name: WORKERS & THE MILITARY
6.groups: Support: economy, government · Opportunity: opposition/land, intl finance · **Crisis: press, courts/law, hidden** · Nagging: people, legislature · Adjacent: markets, foreign power.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: labor, the civil service, the armed forces, public health, as a body

rows.label: money
rows.reading: their pay leans on foreign matters — defense dollars, trade-tied jobs

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: labor/military comms tie to big money and procurement

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: their base is the law — labor law, the UCMJ, the courts

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: their gambit is the government — the general's career, the union's seat at the table

rows.label: daily function
rows.reading: their day-to-day answers to the legislature — authorizations, budgets

rows.label: open enemy
rows.reading: their open enemy hides — the saboteur, the foreign mole, automation

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: their death/rebirth is the people — the draft, the general strike, casualties

rows.label: belief
rows.reading: their creed is the economy — jobs and wages as the faith

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: their public standing is set by the press — how labor and the troops are covered

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: their allies = the land/opposition — the working-class base, the populist party

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: their undoing = the markets — speculation that guts wages, the bubble that lays them off

7.name: A FOREIGN POWER
7.groups: Support: press, legislature · Opportunity: markets, courts/law · **Crisis: people, opposition/land, government** · Nagging: economy, hidden · Adjacent: workers/military, intl finance.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the foreign nation/partner/enemy itself (our read on it)

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the foreign power's money = international finance — *the canonical proof of the method*

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the foreign power talks to us through law, treaty and ideology

rows.label: homeland/leader
rows.reading: the foreign power's homeland and regime show up in our 10th

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: its gambits = the legislature — alliances, treaty ratification, its lobby

rows.label: daily ops
rows.reading: the foreign power's daily operations are hidden — its spies, its proxies

rows.label: open enemy
rows.reading: the foreign power's open enemy is the people — **"we are their 7th"**

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the foreign power's death/rebirth hits our economy — sanctions, the trade war

rows.label: belief
rows.reading: the foreign power's ideology reaches us through the press — propaganda, influence ops

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: the foreign power's foothold = our opposition/land — its agents, the "foreign agent" charge

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: the foreign power's hopes ride the markets — its investments, its leverage

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the foreign power's undoing = our military and workers — the war that breaks it

8.name: INTERNATIONAL FINANCE
8.groups: Support: opposition/land, hidden · Opportunity: workers/military, government · **Crisis: economy, markets, legislature** · Nagging: people, press · Adjacent: foreign power, courts/law.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the world's money, foreign capital, the reserve-currency system

rows.label: money
rows.reading: its money rests on law — treaties, the IMF charter, the legal architecture of finance

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: international finance speaks through the government — the central bank, the Treasury

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: its base = the legislature — the statutes that charter the system

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: its gambits live in the hidden — offshore, shadow banking, the private deal

rows.label: daily function
rows.reading: its daily function rests on the people — whose debt and labor back it

rows.label: rival/partner
rows.reading: its counterpart = the domestic economy — the world's money vs. ours

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: its death/rebirth plays out in the press — the panic headline, the confidence game

rows.label: belief
rows.reading: its ideology meets the land/opposition — the real-asset and sovereignty pushback

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: its power is priced in the markets

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: its allies = labor and the military — who it funds, the defense-finance nexus

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: its undoing = a foreign power — the rival bloc, de-dollarization, the war

9.name: THE COURTS & LAW
9.groups: Support: people, markets · Opportunity: foreign power, legislature · **Crisis: press, workers/military, hidden** · Nagging: economy, opposition/land · Adjacent: intl finance, government.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the judiciary, the law, religion, higher learning

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the courts' resources = the government — who funds and enforces them

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the courts speak through the legislature — the statutes they read

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the courts' base touches the hidden — chambers, sealed dockets, the deep roots of precedent

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the courts' offspring = the people — rulings that remake daily life

rows.label: daily function
rows.reading: the courts' daily grind = the economy — commercial law, the docket of money

rows.label: open counterpart
rows.reading: the courts' open contest = the press — the trial of public opinion

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the courts' death/rebirth = the land/opposition — the landmark case, the constitutional fight

rows.label: philosophy
rows.reading: the courts' guiding doctrine ripples into the markets — the law that prices risk

rows.label: standing/enforcement
rows.reading: the courts' authority = enforcement — the marshals, who carries out the ruling

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: the courts' allies/hopes = foreign affairs — international law, treaties, foreign courts

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the courts' undoing = international finance — the money power that buys around a ruling

10.name: THE GOVERNMENT
10.groups: Support: economy, workers/military · Opportunity: intl finance, hidden · **Crisis: people, opposition/land, foreign power** · Nagging: press, markets · Adjacent: courts/law, legislature.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the administration in power as a body

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the government is funded by the legislature — the purse *is* the appropriations body

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: official comms shade into the hidden — intel, classification, the back channel

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the people are the government's home base — and its ending

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the government's projects = the economy — stimulus, industrial policy

rows.label: daily function
rows.reading: the government's daily grind = the press and the bureaucracy's paper

rows.label: open enemy
rows.reading: the opposition is literally the government's 7th house

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the government's death/rebirth = the markets — the crash that ends an administration

rows.label: ideology
rows.reading: the government's doctrine in action = the civil service and the military it deploys

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: the government's public standing = foreign affairs — its world reputation, the summit

rows.label: allies/funders
rows.reading: the government's friends-with-money = international finance

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the courts are what bring a government down

11.name: THE LEGISLATURE
11.groups: Support: press, foreign power · Opportunity: people, courts/law · **Crisis: economy, markets, intl finance** · Nagging: opposition/land, workers/military · Adjacent: government, hidden.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: Congress, the lawmaking body, allied nations

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the legislature's money = the hidden — lobbying, dark money, the earmark

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the legislature speaks as the people — the representatives' voice

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the legislature's base = the economy — the power of the purse, taxation

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the legislature's gambits = the press — the hearing as theater, the messaging bill

rows.label: daily work
rows.reading: the legislature's daily work = districts and the minority party

rows.label: counterpart
rows.reading: the legislature's counterpart = the markets — the bills that move money

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the legislature's death/rebirth = war powers and the labor vote

rows.label: long view
rows.reading: the legislature's long view = foreign affairs — treaty ratification, the war declaration

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: the legislature's authority = international finance — the debt ceiling, the bond market watching

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: the legislature's allies/hopes = the courts — confirmation, the law it makes

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: **the legislature's self-undoing is the government** — executive overreach that hollows it (the chronicle's "castration" thesis falls out of the geometry)

12.name: THE HIDDEN
12.groups: Support: opposition/land, intl finance · Opportunity: economy, government · **Crisis: press, workers/military, courts/law** · Nagging: markets, foreign power · Adjacent: people, legislature.

rows.label: self
rows.reading: the secret state, subversion, the institutions of confinement

rows.label: money
rows.reading: the hidden's resource is the people — the masses fund the secret state, and pay for subversion

rows.label: messaging
rows.reading: the hidden speaks through money — the bribe, the laundered payment

rows.label: foundation
rows.reading: the hidden's base = the press — the cover story, the controlled narrative

rows.label: ventures
rows.reading: the hidden's gambits = the land/opposition — the underground, the insurgency

rows.label: daily ops
rows.reading: the hidden's daily work = the markets — insider trading, the manipulated tape

rows.label: open enemy
rows.reading: the hidden's open enemy = the military/workers — counter-intelligence, the whistleblower

rows.label: crisis
rows.reading: the hidden's death/rebirth = a foreign power — the plot exposed, the spy swap

rows.label: belief
rows.reading: the hidden's ideology = international finance — the conspiracy of money, *cui bono*

rows.label: standing
rows.reading: when secrets surface, they surface as cases — the hidden's "public standing" is the courts

rows.label: allies
rows.reading: the hidden's allies = the government — the secret state *inside* the state

rows.label: undoing
rows.reading: the hidden's undoing = the legislature — oversight, the investigative committee, sunlight
